tests.name: Cisco IOS and Juniper JunOS BGP peering
tests.input:
Show the BGP peering config between CISCO-EDGE-01 and JUNIPER-CORE-01.

--- CISCO-EDGE-01 (IOS-XE) ---
hostname CISCO-EDGE-01
!
router bgp 65001
 bgp log-neighbor-changes
 neighbor 10.0.100.2 remote-as 65002
 neighbor 10.0.100.2 description PEER_TO_JUNIPER-CORE-01
 neighbor 10.0.100.2 password 7 060506324F41584B
 neighbor 10.0.100.2 route-map RM-JNP-CORE-IN in
 neighbor 10.0.100.2 route-map RM-JNP-CORE-OUT out
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 description LINK_TO_JUNIPER-CORE-01_xe-0/0/0
 ip address 10.0.100.1 255.255.255.252
 mtu 9192
 no shutdown

--- JUNIPER-CORE-01 (JunOS) ---
set system host-name JUNIPER-CORE-01

set interfaces xe-0/0/0 description "LINK_TO_CISCO-EDGE-01_Gi0/0/0"
set interfaces xe-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.100.2/30
set interfaces xe-0/0/0 mtu 9192

set protocols bgp group EBGP-CISCO type external
set protocols bgp group EBGP-CISCO neighbor 10.0.100.1 peer-as 65001
set protocols bgp group EBGP-CISCO neighbor 10.0.100.1 description "PEER_TO_CISCO-EDGE-01"
set protocols bgp group EBGP-CISCO neighbor 10.0.100.1 authentication-key "$9$rKev87Vb2aGi"
set protocols bgp group EBGP-CISCO neighbor 10.0.100.1 import POL-CISCO-EDGE-IN
set protocols bgp group EBGP-CISCO neighbor 10.0.100.1 export POL-CISCO-EDGE-OUT
set protocols bgp group EBGP-CISCO local-as 65002

tests.name: Palo Alto firewall rules vs Cisco ACLs comparison
tests.input:
Compare the firewall rules on PAN-FW-01 with the ACLs on CISCO-EDGE-01 for the DMZ zone.

--- PAN-FW-01 (PAN-OS) ---
set deviceconfig system hostname PAN-FW-01

set network interface ethernet ethernet1/1 layer3 ip 203.0.113.10/30
set network interface ethernet ethernet1/1 comment "OUTSIDE_TO_ISP"
set network interface ethernet ethernet1/2 layer3 ip 10.20.0.1/24
set network interface ethernet ethernet1/2 comment "DMZ_SEGMENT"
set network interface ethernet ethernet1/3 layer3 ip 10.10.0.1/24
set network interface ethernet ethernet1/3 comment "INSIDE_LAN"

set rulebase security rules DMZ-ALLOW-WEB from OUTSIDE to DMZ source any destination 10.20.0.10 application web-browsing action allow
set rulebase security rules DMZ-ALLOW-WEB destination 10.20.0.11 application web-browsing action allow
set rulebase security rules DMZ-ALLOW-SSH from INSIDE to DMZ source 10.10.0.0/24 destination 10.20.0.0/24 application ssh action allow
set rulebase security rules DMZ-DENY-ALL from any to DMZ source any destination any application any action deny log-start yes

--- CISCO-EDGE-01 (IOS) ---
ip access-list extended ACL-DMZ-INBOUND
 remark --- ALLOW WEB TO DMZ SERVERS ---
 permit tcp any host 10.20.0.10 eq 80
 permit tcp any host 10.20.0.10 eq 443
 permit tcp any host 10.20.0.11 eq 80
 permit tcp any host 10.20.0.11 eq 443
 remark --- ALLOW SSH FROM INSIDE ---
 permit tcp 10.10.0.0 0.0.0.255 10.20.0.0 0.0.0.255 eq 22
 remark --- DENY ALL ---
 deny ip any any log
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/2
 description DMZ_SEGMENT
 ip address 10.20.0.254 255.255.255.0
 ip access-group ACL-DMZ-INBOUND in

tests.name: Juniper OSPF and Cisco OSPF interop
tests.input:
Show OSPF config on both sides of the Juniper-Cisco link for area 0.

--- JUNIPER-DIST-01 (JunOS) ---
set system host-name JUNIPER-DIST-01
set interfaces xe-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.50.2/30
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 10.255.10.2/32

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface xe-0/0/1.0 interface-type p2p
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface xe-0/0/1.0 hello-interval 10
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface xe-0/0/1.0 dead-interval 40
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface xe-0/0/1.0 authentication md5 1 key "$9$0EhvMX7Vs2oJD"
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface lo0.0 passive
set routing-options router-id 10.255.10.2

--- CISCO-CORE-01 (IOS-XE) ---
hostname CISCO-CORE-01
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 description LINK_TO_JUNIPER-DIST-01_xe-0/0/1
 ip address 10.0.50.1 255.255.255.252
 ip ospf authentication message-digest
 ip ospf message-digest-key 1 md5 7 01100F175804
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf hello-interval 10
 ip ospf dead-interval 40
!
interface Loopback0
 ip address 10.255.10.1 255.255.255.255
!
router ospf 100
 router-id 10.255.10.1
 passive-interface default
 no passive-interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 network 10.0.50.0 0.0.0.3 area 0
 network 10.255.10.1 0.0.0.0 area 0

tests.name: Three-vendor network — Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto management access
tests.input:
Show management access configs across all three vendors.

--- CISCO-CORE-01 (IOS-XE) ---
hostname CISCO-CORE-01
aaa new-model
aaa authentication login default group tacacs+ local
tacacs server TACACS-PRIMARY
 address ipv4 10.10.5.50
 key 7 094F471A1A0A464058
tacacs server TACACS-BACKUP
 address ipv4 10.10.5.51
 key 7 094F471A1A0A464058
ip access-list standard ACL-VTY
 permit 10.10.5.0 0.0.0.255
 deny any log
line vty 0 15
 access-class ACL-VTY in
 transport input ssh

--- JUNIPER-CORE-01 (JunOS) ---
set system host-name JUNIPER-CORE-01
set system authentication-order [tacplus password]
set system tacplus-server 10.10.5.50 secret "$9$dxVYoZGiPQ36"
set system tacplus-server 10.10.5.50 source-address 10.255.10.2
set system tacplus-server 10.10.5.51 secret "$9$dxVYoZGiPQ36"
set system tacplus-server 10.10.5.51 source-address 10.255.10.2
set system services ssh protocol-version v2
set firewall filter MGMT-ACCESS term ALLOW-SSH from source-prefix-list MGMT-NETS
set firewall filter MGMT-ACCESS term ALLOW-SSH from protocol tcp
set firewall filter MGMT-ACCESS term ALLOW-SSH from destination-port ssh
set firewall filter MGMT-ACCESS term ALLOW-SSH then accept
set firewall filter MGMT-ACCESS term DENY-ALL then reject

--- PAN-FW-01 (PAN-OS) ---
set deviceconfig system hostname PAN-FW-01
set shared authentication-profile TACACS-PROFILE method tacplus
set shared authentication-profile TACACS-PROFILE server-profile TACACS-SERVERS
set shared server-profile tacplus TACACS-SERVERS server TACACS-PRIMARY address 10.10.5.50
set shared server-profile tacplus TACACS-SERVERS server TACACS-PRIMARY secret "T@cP1usSh@red!"
set shared server-profile tacplus TACACS-SERVERS server TACACS-BACKUP address 10.10.5.51
set shared server-profile tacplus TACACS-SERVERS server TACACS-BACKUP secret "T@cP1usSh@red!"
